title: Audio unity array initialization
summary: Recovered the no-argument thiscall method at VA 0x58a120: clear word +0x2448 and store IEEE binary32 1.0 to each of two 32-element arrays at +0x244c and +0x24cc. Direct original disassembly and caller at 0x589f6d confirm the enclosing object base. The loop writes the second array element before the corresponding first array element.
test_description: GCC i386 freestanding differential calls to the original-address accepted reference and recovered member method. Four initial byte patterns, two calls per pattern, all array entries and cleared word checked against independent expected bytes. Full enclosing storage through +0x6fb0 and leading/trailing guards checked for untouched bytes. All rounding modes, sticky MXCSR flags, explicit FS setup and FS-head preservation checked.
known_limits: Field semantics and complete enclosing class layout are unresolved; the header is a partial layout only.
Valid writable objects are required, as in the original; null, inaccessible memory, concurrent observation and fault behavior are not tested.
No matching-byte claim or recovery of the enclosing caller or downstream audio processing.
